properties.name: DataSource
properties.acceptedValues: A DataTable, BindingSource, List<T> or any IList or IListSource
properties.description: The collection the grid displays and edits.
properties.usage: Show database rows or a list of objects.
properties.expectedEffect: The grid shows one row per item.

properties.name: Columns
properties.defaultValue: Empty (filled automatically when a DataSource is set)
properties.description: The columns of the grid.
properties.usage: Define columns by hand.
properties.expectedEffect: A text column named Name with the header Customer appears.

properties.name: Rows
properties.description: The rows of the grid.
properties.usage: Add rows manually when there is no DataSource.
properties.expectedEffect: A new row is added.

properties.name: AllowUserToAddRows
properties.description: Shows the empty row at the bottom that lets users add records.
properties.usage: Turn it off for read-only lists.
properties.expectedEffect: The blank new-row line disappears.

properties.name: ReadOnly
properties.description: Prevents the user from editing cells.
properties.usage: Use the grid only for viewing.
properties.expectedEffect: Cells cannot be edited.

properties.name: SelectionMode
properties.description: What a click selects.
properties.usage: Use FullRowSelect for master lists.
properties.expectedEffect: Clicking a cell highlights its whole row.

properties.name: AutoSizeColumnsMode
properties.acceptedValues: None, ColumnHeader, AllCells, AllCellsExceptHeader, DisplayedCells, DisplayedCellsExceptHeader, Fill
properties.description: How column widths are set automatically.
properties.usage: Use Fill so the columns share the grid width.
properties.expectedEffect: The columns divide the available width.

properties.name: AutoGenerateColumns
properties.description: Whether columns are created automatically from the DataSource.
properties.usage: Set it to false when you define your own columns.
properties.expectedEffect: Only the columns you defined are shown.

properties.name: DataSource
properties.acceptedValues: A list, DataSet, DataTable or a type
properties.description: The data the component manages.
properties.usage: Connect it to your data and bind controls to the BindingSource.
properties.expectedEffect: Bound controls show the data.

properties.name: DataMember
properties.acceptedValues: The name of a list or table inside the DataSource
properties.description: Selects a table or list within a DataSource that contains several.
properties.usage: Pick one table of a DataSet.
properties.expectedEffect: The component works with the Orders table.

properties.name: Filter
properties.acceptedValues: An expression such as "Country = 'France'" (only for lists that support filtering, for example a DataView)
properties.description: Shows only the rows that match the expression.
properties.usage: Implement a quick search box.
properties.expectedEffect: Only matching rows are shown.

properties.name: Sort
properties.acceptedValues: Column names with optional ASC or DESC (only for sortable lists)
properties.description: Orders the rows.
properties.usage: Show the newest first.
properties.expectedEffect: Rows appear in descending order of Date.

properties.name: Position
properties.description: The index of the current item.
properties.usage: Move the selection from code.
properties.expectedEffect: Bound controls show the first item.

properties.name: Current
properties.description: The current item itself.
properties.usage: Read the selected record.
properties.expectedEffect: Returns the object at the current position.

properties.name: List
properties.description: The list the component currently exposes after filtering and sorting.
properties.usage: Inspect or count the visible items.
properties.expectedEffect: Returns the list that bound controls see.

properties.name: BindingSource
properties.description: The data source the navigator moves through and edits.
properties.usage: Connect the toolbar to your data.
properties.expectedEffect: The buttons now control bindingSource1.

properties.name: PositionItem
properties.defaultValue: null (the designer creates the standard items)
properties.acceptedValues: A ToolStripItem, usually a text box
properties.description: The item that shows the current position.
properties.usage: Replace it with your own item.
properties.expectedEffect: This item shows and edits the current position.

properties.name: CountItem
properties.defaultValue: null (the designer creates the standard items)
properties.description: The item that shows the total count.
properties.usage: Use a custom label for the count.
properties.expectedEffect: The label shows the number of records.

properties.name: MoveFirstItem
properties.defaultValue: null (the designer creates the standard items)
properties.description: The button that jumps to the first record.
properties.usage: Assign your own button.
properties.expectedEffect: Clicking the button moves to the first record.

properties.name: AddNewItem
properties.defaultValue: null (the designer creates the standard items)
properties.description: The button that adds a new record.
properties.usage: Assign your own Add button.
properties.expectedEffect: Clicking the button adds a record.

properties.name: DeleteItem
properties.defaultValue: null (the designer creates the standard items)
properties.description: The button that deletes the current record.
properties.usage: Assign your own Delete button.
properties.expectedEffect: Clicking the button deletes the current record.
